{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

::: remark

Probability and statistics describe events, outcomes, and parameters as sets.
This page collects the definitions of sets
that the Morrison Lab's probability and statistics notes build on.
The [Functions](functions.qmd) page defines functions between sets,
and the [Expressions and Algorithms](expressions-algorithms.qmd) page defines
the expressions that write functions down and the algorithms that compute them.

:::
